limitations: Nested alternatives; do not sum 250/500/1000 m options.
Water follows frozen OSM coastline retrieved 2026-10-26 UTC; not reconstructed for February 2025.
Mapped water is not proof of navigability, depth, authorized anchorage, instantaneous shoreline or vessel activity.
STC V1 fondeo includes substantial mapped land; these outer rings do not silently repair its baseline polygon.
Within-frame geometry does not verify valid pixels, detector coverage, scene completeness, context availability or vessel counts.
No image content, labels, detections, AIS or reserved data informed these contours.
No extra 20 m coastal exclusion was applied; land and unclassified areas are excluded geometrically.
